# cellxgene_datasets_v

One row per CELLxGENE Discover dataset version in the loaded release: collection, title,
DOI, citation, cells aggregated and gene counts. `release` names the release the cellxgene_*
views were loaded from; min_cells and min_donors are its suppression thresholds.

## Columns

| column | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset_key` | `INT64` | Release-local key |
| `dataset_id` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE dataset (stable across versions) |
| `dataset_version_id` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE dataset version |
| `collection_id` | `STRING` | CELLxGENE collection |
| `collection_name` | `STRING` | Collection name |
| `title` | `STRING` | Dataset title |
| `collection_doi` | `STRING` | Publication DOI of the collection |
| `citation` | `STRING` | Citation string from CELLxGENE |
| `cells_kept` | `INT64` | Primary cells aggregated |
| `n_groups` | `INT64` | Cell groups, before suppression |
| `n_genes` | `INT64` | Features in the source file |
| `n_genes_measured` | `INT64` | Features the dataset measured |
| `n_genes_mapped` | `INT64` | Measured features mapped to GENCODE v49 |
| `release` | `STRING` | Release the cellxgene_* views were loaded from |
| `min_cells` | `INT64` | Suppression threshold: cells per group |
| `min_donors` | `INT64` | Suppression threshold: donors per group |

## Worked examples

Queries that run against cellxgene_datasets_v as written.

### Largest CELLxGENE datasets in the release, with citations

```sql
SELECT title, collection_name, collection_doi, cells_kept, release FROM cellxgene_datasets_v ORDER BY cells_kept DESC LIMIT 20
```
